notes:
Improved
• Solis AI now reads what's said, not just how loud it is. A goodbye or a serious talk gets emotional or calm music instead of a hype intro. A video titled like a goodbye ("… is leaving …") counts as on
• Sound effects: the punchlines, shocks, wins and fails Solis AI picks out get a sound, and so do big surprised reactions and laughs. In a sad stretch only a real joke gets one.
• Every pop-up pops: images and labels now get their pop sound. Before, they were added after the sounds were planned, so they never got one. The same pop comes back for each pop-up, the way editors do;
• Things named by what they are now pop up: "Slob Clan", "group channel", "my first channel", "Minecraft channel", "YouTube shorts", "2 million subscribers". So do games and people said in passing, like
• Up to two a minute in Long Form, never two within 8 seconds. The same thing spelled two ways ("Slob Clan" and "Slub Clan") shows once. Talk about "this video" is never a pop-up.
• Solis AI's answers are read however the model lays them out. Before, answers written on one line were dropped, which also hurt story judgment.
• Revisions keep the reactions and the read their edit was planned with.
